bugs.error_message: Refresh could issue a replacement after concurrent revocation or misclassify a revoked token as a refresh race.
bugs.root_cause: Account state was read before the transaction and token rows were changed without a shared account lock order.
bugs.fix: Serialize credential mutations on the PostgreSQL user row and re-read token state after locking.

bugs.error_message: Any nonempty CSRF header passed cookie refresh and logout validation.
bugs.root_cause: The header was checked for presence but never compared with a session-side value.
bugs.fix: Issue a random readable CSRF cookie, compare it to the header, and validate exact allowed origins.

bugs.error_message: Generated initial migration declared each PostgreSQL enum twice, including a nonexistent schema.
bugs.root_cause: HasPostgresEnum was called with the enum name as the schema argument while MapEnum already registered the enum.
bugs.fix: Remove duplicate explicit enum registrations and regenerate the new initial migration.

bugs.error_message: Login and refresh returned the Host account ID twice, once as accountId and once as tenantId; JWTs also emitted tenantId.
bugs.root_cause: Stale Auth requirements were applied despite the current model using HostAccountId and no separate tenant ID.
bugs.fix: Remove tenantId from Auth responses, JWT generation and validation, and align affected requirements with HostAccountId.
